name: @pipeworx/mcp-gie-storage

tools.name: gie_gas_storage
tools.description: European natural gas storage levels from GIE AGSI+: how full EU gas storage is (fill % of working gas volume), gas in storage in TWh, daily injection and withdrawal, trend, and the gas day — for the whole EU, one country (e.g. Germany "DE", Italy "IT"), one storage operator or one facility. Omit dates for the latest gas day; pass from/to for a daily series. Served with Pipeworx's own GIE key, so callers need none; pass your own free GIE key as _apiKey to use it instead.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. "DE", "IT", "NL", "FR". Omit or pass "EU" for the EU aggregate.

company.description: Storage operator EIC code (operator_eic from gie_storage_facilities). Needs country.

facility.description: Storage facility EIC code (facility eic from gie_storage_facilities). Needs country and company.

days.description: Max gas days to return (1-300). Default 1 with no dates (latest day), 30 with dates.

_apiKey.description: Optional. Your own GIE API key (sent as the x-key header); Pipeworx supplies its platform key when omitted. Register free at https://agsi.gie.eu/account.

tools.name: gie_lng_terminals
tools.description: European LNG terminal levels from GIE ALSI+: LNG inventory in the tanks (1000 m3 LNG and GWh), daily send-out into the gas grid, and declared maximum inventory and send-out capacity — for the EU, a country (e.g. Spain "ES", France "FR"), an LNG operator or one terminal. Omit dates for the latest gas day. Served with Pipeworx's own GIE key, so callers need none; pass your own free GIE key as _apiKey to use it instead.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. "ES", "FR", "NL", "DE". Omit or pass "EU" for the EU aggregate.

company.description: LNG operator EIC code (operator_eic from gie_storage_facilities with dataset "lng"). Needs country.

facility.description: LNG terminal EIC code (facility eic from gie_storage_facilities with dataset "lng"). Needs country and company.

days.description: Max gas days to return (1-300). Default 1 with no dates (latest day), 30 with dates.

_apiKey.description: Optional. Your own GIE API key (sent as the x-key header); Pipeworx supplies its platform key when omitted. Register free at https://agsi.gie.eu/account.

tools.name: gie_storage_facilities
tools.description: Directory of European underground gas storage sites and LNG terminals reporting to GIE (AGSI+ / ALSI+): every storage system operator and LNG operator by country, with each facility's name, type and EIC code and operational dates. Use it to find which storage sites or LNG terminals a country has, or the EIC codes the other GIE tools filter on. Keyless.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to filter by, e.g. "DE".

query.description: Case-insensitive name fragment or exact EIC code of an operator or facility, e.g. "Rehden", "Uniper", "Zeebrugge".

include_closed.description: Also list facilities with an operational end date (decommissioned or historical series). Default false.

tools.name: gie_storage_outages
tools.description: Planned and unplanned outages (unavailability reports) at European gas storage sites and LNG terminals, from GIE AGSI+ / ALSI+: which facility, start and end time, whether the end is confirmed or estimated, the injection / withdrawal (or LNG send-out) capacity taken offline, and the operator's reason. Newest reports first; filter by country, operator, facility, publication date window or planned/unplanned. Keyless.

facility.description: Facility EIC code (facility eic from gie_storage_facilities); country and operator are resolved for you.

type.description: Only planned maintenance or only unplanned outages.

from.description: Only reports published on/after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

to.description: Only reports published on/before this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-gie-storage forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the gie-storage pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
